original_evidence.text: | lazygit | github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit | Go (CLI/TUI) | Y | configurable: default `prompt` (asks before download+install); user can set `update.method: background` for fully automatic chk+dl+inst with no confirmation; disabled entirely on Windows and for non-official/non-`buildBinary` builds | Y | HTTPS (`github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/releases/...`, Go `net/http` default client); TLS validation ENFORCED (no `InsecureSkipVerify` anywhere in repo) | N (no manifest at all — just GitHub Releases API `tag_name` JSON field and a HEAD request to check asset exists) | none — no hash, checksum, or signature check of the downloaded tarball/zip before extracting and replacing the running binary; only check is HTTP 200 status via `verifyResourceFound()` HEAD request | n/a (no signing key used) | pkg/updates/updates.go:47-69 (`getLatestVersionNumber()` GETs `RepoUrl+"/releases/latest"` for `tag_name`), :222-235 (`getBinaryUrl()` builds direct HTTPS download URL to release tarball/zip), :242-318 (`update()`/`downloadAndInstall()`: `http.Get(rawUrl)`, writes to temp file, `tar -zxf`, then `os.Rename(tempLazygitFilePath, binaryPath)` — overwrites running binary with NO hash/signature check), :320-329 (`verifyResourceFound` only HEAD-checks HTTP 200, not integrity), pkg/config/user_config.go:441-446 (`UpdateConfig.Method` enum prompt/background/never) and :983-986 (default `Method: "prompt"`, `Days: 14`), pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/update_helper.go:24-40 (`CheckForUpdateInBackground`: if `Method == "background"` calls `startUpdating` directly with no user confirmation, else shows confirm prompt), pkg/constants/links.go:22 (`RepoUrl: "https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit"`); negative grep for InsecureSkipVerify (verified 2026-08-19) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: configurable: default `prompt` (asks before download+install); user can set `update.method: background` for fully automatic chk+dl+inst with no confirmation; disabled entirely on Windows and for non-official/non-`buildBinary` builds

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS (`github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/releases/...`, Go `net/http` default client); TLS validation ENFORCED (no `InsecureSkipVerify` anywhere in repo)

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: N (no manifest at all — just GitHub Releases API `tag_name` JSON field and a HEAD request to check asset exists)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: none — no hash, checksum, or signature check of the downloaded tarball/zip before extracting and replacing the running binary; only check is HTTP 200 status via `verifyResourceFound()` HEAD request
